dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Progressive, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the wide mid-section towards the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity corresponds to a uniform medium-grey skin tone.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker-grey mottling patches distributed across the mid-dorsal and posterior regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the baseline grey and subtly darker mottled regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, high-contrast circular blowhole located on the anterior dorsal surface of the head.
